name: UnleashX
summary: Platform to 'hire' AI employees by role that run workflows across your CRM and tools, voice and video included.
description: UnleashX lets teams pick an AI employee role, connect their CRM and tools, set rules and hand over end-to-end workflows, with humans stepping in only when needed. It includes voice and video agents and Leasha, a super-agent. Pay-as-you-go: free to start with 1,000 credits, then usage plus model costs, no monthly commitment.
